integrity: The proof reconstructs the source equations and gives an analytic all-parameter argument. Finite exact arithmetic tests supplement, but do not replace, that proof. The available comparisons cannot exclude every unpublished or unindexed equivalent result.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to equal-sized deterministic mean-field communities, \(b,c>0\) and \(e,f\in[0,1]\). The upper-side attainability is existential over parameter tuples with fixed \(u=be,v=cf\); no pointwise sufficiency or stability follows. Disconnected-community boundary equilibria require separate treatment; unequal communities and finite stochastic networks are not covered.
title: A sharp effective-assortativity barrier for asymmetric equilibria in two-community hypergraph contagion
